metadata.title: Budget Against Attack at a Deep Pool, and Pace Against Trigger

story.iWant: the price-defense boundary mapped against attack size at a deep pool, and defender pace separated from trigger
story.soThat: F-11's withdrawn clause is replaced by a tested one and F-13 names the right parameter
story.tasks: - Budget × attack (AC: 1–3) - Pace × trigger (AC: 4–6) - ADR, figures, close out (AC: 7, 8)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–8. The price-loss metric (never re-enters) is normative for AC 2; time-to-parity from run start for AC 5.

existing.reason: Reuse the crossing and time-to-parity helpers; add plot_budget_attack and plot_pace_trigger.

story-context.constraints: - No kernel/ or protocol/ changes; no config changes; every scenario hash unchanged. - Charts read parquet + manifest only; no hand-tuned axes. - Python 3.12-compatible.

tests.standards: pytest; synthetic parquet for both charts (crossing monotone in one; three-axis grid in the other); spec files load and expand to 200 and 256 cells.
